verdict.rationale: Buzz's own docs say the same OSS codebase can run as your own relay, and the repo ships a single-node/VPS Compose bundle plus a Helm chart with production and quickstart profiles that needs no external services. A probe confirmed the Helm chart is publicly pullable from GHCR in eight published versions. missing for 10: independent hands-on report of an actual self-hosted deployment running successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Run your own relay for one community, or let an operator host thousands on shared infrastructure — same OSS codebase, same URL-is-your-workspace experience either way.
This is the single-node/VPS deployment bundle.
the documented `helm install ... oci://ghcr.io/block/buzz/charts/buzz` distribution is live
